extracted.intended_audience: corporations, public_relations and investor_relations professionals evaluating newswire/distribution services
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and criteria for evaluating and choosing a commercial newswire service to distribute press releases, regulatory filings, photos and other multimedia to journalists, financial professionals, regulators and the public worldwide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full-text and multimedia distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Transmit full-text news releases, regulatory filings, photos and other multimedia content to journalists, financial professionals, investor services, regulatory authorities and the general public worldwide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Business Wire positions itself as able to 'transmit their full-text news releases, regulatory filings, photos and other multimedia content' and to originate hundreds of thousands of news announcements each year; implies the service should preserve full content and distribute it broadly and intact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulatory disclosure and filing support
rubrics_metrics.description: Services for satisfying regulatory obligations in the US and around the globe, including in-house EDGAR filing capabilities and support for SEDAR and UK Regulatory filings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Business Wire highlights its 'in-house EDGAR team - an industry first' and being 'the largest EDGAR filer in the newswire sector.' Criterion includes ability to file required regulatory disclosures (EDGAR, SEDAR, UK filings, and other jurisdictions named).

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry- and issue-specific targeted delivery
rubrics_metrics.description: Highly targeted news delivery through industry-specific networks and issue-specific circuits (e.g., AutomotiveWire, EntertainmentWire, HealthWire, SportsWire, CSR Circuit, Public Policy Circuits).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Business Wire offers 'more than 200 industry segments to provide highly targeted news delivery' and services for issue-specific news such as corporate social responsibility and public policy — evaluate granularity and relevance of targeting segments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demographic targeting
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to target demographic markets such as Hispanic, African and Asian American audiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page lists demographic markets explicitly; criterion is whether the distributor can target releases to specific demographic audiences and communities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global reach and agency partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Worldwide proprietary news network and affiliations with major news agencies allowing targeting to many countries and languages; carriage/access with leading news organizations (Agence France-Presse, Associated Press, Bloomberg, Dow Jones, Reuters).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Business Wire claims ability to target releases to 'more than 145 countries and 45 languages' and that it is 'the only third-party content provider with access to the Associated Press's worldwide media network' and first to gain access to AFP — evaluate distributor's global partnerships and full-text carriage agreements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photo and multimedia distribution capabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Robust photo and multimedia distribution (Smart News Release platform, Photo Smart News Releases posted to Yahoo! Finance, distributed to daily newspapers via AP photo network, and posted to community and industry websites).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Business Wire's 'Smart News Release' and 'Photo Smart News Releases' are given as specific product examples — assess how multimedia is packaged, which partners/sites receive photos and multimedia, and geographic/photo-agency reach (UK/Europe/Asia).

rubrics_metrics.name: Measurement, monitoring and analytics
rubrics_metrics.description: Provision of distribution statistics, website posting reports, online viewership data, media clips, media intelligence, reputation management and analytics to measure the impact of news releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Business Wire's NewsTrak suite is cited; criterion includes availability and depth of analytics, types of reports, and tools for reputation/media intelligence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trade show and conference integration
rubrics_metrics.description: Integrated communications tools and partnerships with trade shows and financial conferences, including Official Wire status at events to provide additional exposure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Business Wire emphasizes its trade show & conference division and 'Official Wire status' at dozens of shows — evaluate whether distributor offers event-focused services and additional exposure opportunities through show partnerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local newsrooms and personalized customer service
rubrics_metrics.description: Availability of localized support through multiple newsrooms, personalized customer service, fast turnaround and higher accuracy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Business Wire claims 'more newsrooms than any other commercial newswire' and emphasizes 'personalized customer service' and 'fast turnaround' — criterion is local/regional support, responsiveness and editorial/accuracy assistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Market leadership, volume and credibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstrated market leadership and volume of distributed announcements (originating hundreds of thousands of news announcements yearly) and credibility in capital and commercial markets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Business Wire frames scale and longstanding credibility ('more than 45 years of experience') as value; use volume, tenure and reputation as evaluation factors when selecting a distribution service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language and country coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to distribute to multiple languages and many countries (cited: 45 languages, 145 countries).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate the breadth of language support and country-level distribution options; Business Wire highlights multilingual and multinational reach as a selling point.
